programme.title: The Kitchen - Rainhas Do Crime
programme.desc: Bairro de Hell’s Kitchen, em 1978. Três donas de casa veem os maridos mafiosos presos pelo FBI. Com poucos recursos, decidem ocupar-se pessoalmente das questões da máfia irlandesa, revelando-se inesperadamente hábeis em tudo, da gestão de extorsões à eliminação dos concorrentes... literalmente.

programme.title: Sin City: Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: Os Filhos Do Homem
programme.desc: No ano de 2027, dezoito anos após o nascimento da última criança, Theo torna-se o herói improvável da raça humana ao ser requisitado pela ex-companheira para escoltar uma jovem grávida para fora do país. Numa corrida contra o tempo, Theo irá arriscar tudo para dar à luz o milagre há muito esperado.

programme.title: O Hóspede
programme.desc: David é um soldado que se apresenta à família Peterson como amigo próximo do seu filho, que morreu em combate. Só que após acolher o jovem em casa, o casal começa a aperceber-se que há uma série de mortes que começam a assombrar a cidade, e que parecem estar todas ligadas à sua presença.

programme.title: Mojin e o Templo Perdido
programme.desc: No início da década de 90, o famoso explorador de túmulos Hu Bayi decidiu reformar-se com a sua noiva, Shirley, mas são convencidos a regressar às lides por uma mulher misteriosa, que quer descobrir o túmulo de uma princesa mongol para possuir um artefacto que tem o poder de ressuscitar os mortos.

programme.title: Para Roma Com Amor
programme.desc: Um casal em lua de mel, um arquiteto que regressa à rua onde viveu em estudante, um homem que se torna uma celebridade da noite para o dia e um diretor funerário tenta cumprir o sonho de ser cantor de ópera: quatro histórias que se cruzam na gloriosa cidade de Roma.

programme.title: O Amor E A Vida Real
programme.desc: Dan Burns é um colunista, especialista em aconselhamento familiar, mas com dificuldade em sobreviver como irmão e como pai viúvo de três filhas precoces. As coisas tornam-se ainda mais complicadas quando Dan descobre que a sua apaixonada secreta é na realidade a nova namorada do irmão…

programme.title: Um Reino Unido
programme.desc: No fim da década de 1940, o príncipe herdeiro do Botsuana apaixona-se por uma mulher britânica e branca. A união não agrada à política de apartheid de Daniel Malan, e tanto a África do Sul como o Reino Unido farão tudo para impedir o casamento, mas o amor pode falar mais alto que o dever.

programme.title: Fúria De Viver
programme.desc: Jim Stark é o novo adolescente na cidade, cuja solidão, frustração e raiva refletem os sentimentos da juventude do pós-guerra. Agora, ele espera encontrar o amor com Judy e começa uma amizade com Plato e Ray, mas vai ser posto à prova entre corridas de carros e lutas com facas.

programme.title: Snitch - Infiltrado
programme.desc: Com o filho adolescente injustamente acusado de tráfico de droga, John Matthews faz um acordo para trabalhar numa perigosa missão como informador infiltrado junto de traficantes, arriscando tudo, incluindo a família e a própria vida.

programme.title: Fora de Controlo
programme.desc: Thomas Craven é um veterano da polícia que investiga o homicídio da própria filha, na sequência do qual descobre uma conspiração empresarial e governamental de proporções inesperadas.

programme.title: Força Da Natureza
programme.desc: Uma quadrilha de ladrões planeia um assalto num velho complexo de apartamentos de Porto Rico quando um grande furacão se abate sobre o local. Mas a tarefa vai ser complicada por um polícia que lá está destacado para evacuar o local e um ex-polícia ansioso por voltar ao ativo.

programme.title: Hércules - A Lenda Começa
programme.desc: Em 1200 a.C, na Grécia Antiga, o príncipe Hércules desconhece que é filho de Zeus e só deseja o amor da Princesa de Creta, prometida em casamento ao seu irmão. Agora, ele vai ter de fazer uma escolha: fugir com o seu verdadeiro amor ou cumprir o seu destino e tornar-se o grande herói do seu tempo.

programme.title: Os Filhos Do Homem
programme.desc: No ano de 2027, dezoito anos após o nascimento da última criança, Theo torna-se o herói improvável da raça humana ao ser requisitado pela ex-companheira para escoltar uma jovem grávida para fora do país. Numa corrida contra o tempo, Theo irá arriscar tudo para dar à luz o milagre há muito esperado.

programme.title: Matando Salazar
programme.desc: Uma equipa de elite de agentes de combate à droga tem por missão proteger um barão do narcotráfico num hotel de luxo. Enquanto aguardam pela extração do criminoso, veem-se no centro de uma emboscada quando os antigos associados do traficante lançam um ataque cerrado ao local.

programme.title: Zona De Perigo
programme.desc: Abby Trent é uma agente da CIA que gere uma prisão clandestina de alto risco. Quando capturam Hatchet, o homem mais perigoso do mundo e um mestre na arte da fuga, ele inicia um jogo sangrento, eliminando os oficiais um a um. Abby descobre que está rodeada de traidores. Em quem pode confiar?

programme.title: Uma Boa Dose De Sexo
programme.desc: Adam, Mike e Neil são três homens que não têm quase nada em comum, exceto serem todos viciados em sexo e estarem em diferentes estágios de recuperação.

programme.title: O Assassinato De Nicole Brown Simpson
programme.desc: Vinte e cinco anos após a morte de Nicole Brown Simpson, este thriller explora os dias que antecederam o assassinato, com uma nova tese sobre o autor do crime, que se afasta do ex-marido O. J. Simpson e envolve o serial-killer Glen Rogers.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Quando um louco rapta um rapaz e o armadilha com explosivos, o agente Ray desafia o seu capitão, toma as rédeas da situação e entra em contra-relógio para salvar a criança inocente.

programme.title: O Livro Das Soluções
programme.desc: Marc é um realizador de cinema que leva toda a sua equipa de produção para a pequena aldeia de Cévennes, onde a sua a criatividade gera milhões de ideias que o mergulham no caos total, o que o leva a escrever um guia de conselhos práticos, ‘O Livro das Soluções’…

programme.title: Mulher De Ouro
programme.desc: Maria Altmann, uma octogenária judia austríaca refugiada nos EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para recuperar os bens da sua família apreendidos pelos nazis, entre eles um famoso quadro de Gustav Klimt, missão em que será ajudada por um corajoso mas inexperiente advogado.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: Extremamente Perverso, Escandalosamente Cruel E Vil
programme.desc: Ted é um homem bonito, inteligente e afetuoso. Liz é uma mãe solteira, cautelosa, mas apaixonada. Imagem da felicidade doméstica, a vida deste casal parece perfeita até ele ser preso e acusado de vários assassínios tenebrosos. Ele é Ted Bundy e torna-se o serial-killer mais famoso da América.

programme.title: 57 Segundos
programme.desc: Franklin Fausti é um blogger que consegue uma entrevista com Anton Burrell, um guru da tecnologia, e que acaba por lhe salvar a vida no lançamento do seu mais recente produto. Nesse processo, encontra um anel misterioso que permite a quem o usa recuar 57 segundos para o passado.

programme.title: Ousadas E Golpistas
programme.desc: Um grupo de strippers de Nova Iorque droga os homens de negócios de Wall Street que visitam o clube e depois rouba-lhes dinheiro do cartão de crédito, sabendo que eles não poderão ir à polícia sem denunciar que lá estiveram. Só que a prática alastra-se e o perigo torna-se muito real.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Após sobreviver à morte, a assassina contratada Elektra, perita em martes marciais, acaba por ver-se a proteger os seus dois alvos, um pai solteiro e a sua única filha, de um grupo de criminosos sobrenaturais.

programme.title: Magia E Sedução
programme.desc: Sally e Gillian Owens são duas irmãs descendentes de uma família de bruxas que carrega uma maldição centenária. Agora elas terão de enfrentar vários feitiços inesperados e ultrapassar todos os obstáculos para encontrar o verdadeiro amor.

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros…

programme.title: The Kitchen - Rainhas Do Crime
programme.desc: Bairro de Hell’s Kitchen, em 1978. Três donas de casa veem os maridos mafiosos presos pelo FBI. Com poucos recursos, decidem ocupar-se pessoalmente das questões da máfia irlandesa, revelando-se inesperadamente hábeis em tudo, da gestão de extorsões à eliminação dos concorrentes... literalmente.

programme.title: O Diário de uma Rapariga Adolescente
programme.desc: Minnie Goetze tem 15 anos, quer ser desenhadora de BD e está a crescer no ambiente frenético da São Francisco dos anos 70. É uma típica adolescente em quase tudo, exceto no facto de descobrir o sexo com o namorado da mãe, com quem acaba por manter uma relação, mesmo depois desta descobrir...

programme.title: Bizet - Carmen
programme.desc: The wild and breathtaking scenery of Austria's Roman Quarry of St. Margarethen provides an ideal and unique backdrop for this live and colourful open-air performance of Georges Bizet's opera Carmen (1875). With over 400 participants, this opulent staging of Bizet's famous opera - one of the most popular works in the genre's history - proves a feast for all the senses. Austria's Opera Festival St.

programme.title: Christa Ludwig - Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Christa Ludwig offers a last performance before taking her leave of the opera and concert stage. In a final Lieder recital from the Wiener Musikverein, honouring the city that has seen her greatest triumphs and that has been her spiritual home, Ms. Ludwig performs a select repertoire of Beethoven, Schubert, Mahler and Wolf.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Pictures at an Exhibition
programme.desc: Conductor Mariss Jansons, the Bavarian Radio Symphony Orchestra and Mussorgsky's “Pictures at an Exhibition” were predestined to come together.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Cello Suite No. 1 in G major, BWV 1007
programme.desc: At St. Bartholomew Church in Dornheim, Germany, where composer Johann Sebastian Bach married his first wife Maria Barbara, renowned Dutch cellist Anner Bijlsma performs the composer's Cello Suite No. 1 in G major, BWV 1007. It is likely Bach wrote his collection of six Suites for unaccompanied cello during the years 1717-1723.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988)
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff And Dvorák Trios
programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Eeva Koskinen (violin), René Geesing (cello) and Ingo Lulofs (piano) plays Rachmaninoff’s Trio élégiaque Nr. 1 and the Finale of Dvorák’s Piano Trio No.3, Op. 65. Rachmaninoff composed this Trio in 1892 at the age of 19. The work does not have an opus number and consists only of one movement, which is highly unusual for a Piano Trio.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed.

programme.title: Schubert - String Quartet No. 15 in G major
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Lang Lang – The Third Dimension
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Lang Lang performs some of the greatest works in the piano repertoire at Berghain in Berlin in 2010. The concert program includes the first movement of Piano Sonata No. 23, op. 57, called Beethoven's Appassionata, the precipato of Prokofiev's Sonata No. 7, and the mention of Iberia (Book 1), the masterpiece of Isaac Albéniz. Lang Lang closes the evening with a powerful version of the ''Heroic'' Polonaise, op.

programme.title: Chamber music by Janácek, Taffanel and Prokofiev
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of the ‘Solistas del Siglo XXI’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. First, Quinteto Zéphyros performs Leoš Janácek’s Mládí (‘Youth’) for wind sextet. This is followed by French flautist Paul Taffanel’s Wind Quintet in G minor, performed by Quinteto Scarlatti de Casa de la Moneda. The program closes with Sergei Prokofiev’s Quintet in G minor, Op. 39, played by Quinteto Cosan.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Preludes and fugues
programme.desc: Compagnia Simona Bucci presents an extraordinary concert in scenic form: 'Preludi e Fughe - Geografia antropica'. Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87 inspired choreographer Simona Bucci to take on this project. Seven dancers of Compagnia Simona Bucci dance to Shostakovich’s Preludes and Fugues Nos. 1, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 24, played by Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda.

programme.title: Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. La damnation de Faust is a work born of the composer’s obsession with Goethe’s legendary tale. Once a righteous scholar, Faust allows himself to be corrupted by the devil, and drags the innocent around him into desperation and death.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Intro and Rondo Capriccioso, Op. 28
programme.desc: The Waldbühne in Berlin, one of the most appealing outdoor amphitheatres on the European continent, is the home of the Berliner Philharmoniker’s summer concerts. With over 22.000 in attendance, they are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world.

programme.title: Recursivo
programme.desc: The Mexico City Ballet (MXCB) is a contemporary ballet company made up of highly experienced international dancers, residents of Mexico City. International guest dancers help celebrate the anniversary gala of the Mexico City Ballet, featuring the fantastic works of MXCB’s resident choreographer, Yazmín Barragán.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven And Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Cello: Busoni, Liszt, Chopin And Rachmaninoff
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni’s Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong; Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano; Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3; and Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 5, Op. 64
programme.desc: In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Haydn, Schubert et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Ema Nikolovska (Canada, 1993) and pianist Michael Sikich (United States, 1993) perform ‘The sailor’s song’ from Joseph Haydn’s Six original canzonettas, Book 2 – Hob. XXVIa; Franz Schubert’s Auf dem See, Op. 92 No. 2 (D. 543); ‘Botschaft’ from Johannes Brahms’s Fünf Lieder, Op. 47; ‘Röselein, Röselein!’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Nutcracker 2011
programme.desc: This stunning performance of theatrical ice dancing brings viewers into the enchanting world of Tchaikovsky's magnificent holiday classic, The Nutcracker On Ice, performed by the internationally renowned Imperial Ice Stars, and including former champion figure skaters, Vadim Yarkov and Olga Sharutenko. This very special performance and soundtrack was performed by the Manchester Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Tim A.

programme.title: Donizetti – L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: With Rolando Villazón directing and playing the title role, the world rushed for tickets to the Baden-Baden 2012 Pentecost-holiday opera. Following his directorial debut in 2011 (Werther, Lyon) the Mexican tenor went a step further, staging Gaetano Donizetti’s L’elisir d’amore and directing himself in the role of Nemorino.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Beethoven's Symphony no 9 is interpreted by the Berlin Philharmonic under former chief conductor Claudio Abbado at the Berliner Philharmonie in 2001. The recording features interpretations that are the fruit of decades of Claudio Abbado’s involvement with Beethoven.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. This performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Mozart
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: German Brass goes Bach
programme.desc: The German Brass ensemble delivers some of Bach's most popular tunes in breathtaking brass arrangements. Recorded live from the magnificent St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, this concert features timeless pieces by the legendary German composer, such as Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Adagio in G minor, and Jesus bleibet meine Freude.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Arvo Pärt - Kanon Pokajanen
programme.desc: Arvo Pärt based his ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ (from ‘Canon of Repentance to Our Lord Jesus Christ’, 1995-97) on the canon of repentance as handed down in the earliest Slavic-Christian manuscripts, dating back to the sixth century after Christ. The canon symbolizes the change, the transformation from day to night, the Old and New Testament, prophecy and the fulfillment, the here and now and the hereafter.

programme.title: Chopin - Introduction And Polonaise, Op. 3
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I
programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.

programme.title: Bellini/Liszt - Réminiscences de Norma S.394
programme.desc: Minsoo Hong (1993, South Korea) performs Liszt’s Sposalizio from Années de Pèlerinage: Deuxième Année (S161/1) and Bellini/Liszt’s Réminiscences de Norma (S394) during the Solo Finals of the11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Christmas Concert
programme.desc: On 18 December 2017, the Valerius Ensemble played a Christmas concert in Concordia, Enschede. The ensemble consists of Robert Windak (violin), Annemarie van Vliegen (violin), Eva Šušliková (viola) and Réne Geesing (cello). The program consists of “Das neugeborne Kindelein” from Bachs Cantata BWV 122, the Largo from Vivaldi’s Winter, the Allegro from Mozart’s Divertimento in D (KV.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvorák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvorák’s broader oeuvre.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 6 and 15
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience.

programme.title: Couperin - Deuxième livre, A step into the unknown
programme.desc: With her superb technique, intelligence, taste and refinement, Carole Cerasi is the dream interpreter for Couperin‘s second book, Pièces de Clavecin. More so than the first part, which is a compendium of older compositions, this volume indicates the path the composer now wished to take: style and form become more modern, and there is room for evocative mood pieces and musical portraits.

programme.title: Piano works by Mendelssohn
programme.desc: The Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (*1975) is considered one of today’s leading interpreters of Felix Mendelssohn’s piano repertoire. Prosseda’s discovery of unknown Mendelssohn compositions made the headlines throughout Europe and led to several releases on the celebrated Decca label.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Considered by Bruckner as the artistic climax of his career, the Symphony No. 8 followed in the wake of the triumphs celebrated by his 7th Symphony and Te Deum. Yet the conductor put aside the original version of the work – which Franz Welser-Möst conducts here – when his friend the conductor Hermann Levi rejected it. The original version was first performed in 1954 and first published in 1972.

programme.title: Jansons conductcs Stravinsky, Hummel And Beethoven
programme.desc: “Everything about Mariss Jansons exudes joy and sovereignty” raved Süddeutsche Zeitung in January 2018, when the celebrated conductor celebrated his 75th birthday at Munich's Philharmonie am Gasteig with a concert program that centered around the music of Stravinsky, Hummel and Beethoven.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home
programme.desc: On December 24, 2011, one of the world’s most renowned classical orchestras, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, celebrated the 75th anniversary of its founding. The film portrays the orchestra and its eventful history against the backdrop of Israel and the holocaust.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff: Piano Concerto No. 3,Op 30
programme.desc: The legendary pianist Vladimir Horowitz (1903-1989) won his first praise on his interpretation of Rachmaninoff's Third Piano Concerto from the composer himself. When Rachmaninoff heard the young Kiev-born pianist play his work shortly after Horowitz's arrival in New York in 1928, he exclaimed: 'He swallowed it whole.' Fifty years later, on September 24, 1978, Horowitz electrified his audience once again with this monumental work.

programme.title: Dvorák - Rusalka
programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). The work’s libretto is written by Czech poet Jaroslav Kvapil. Rusalka, an elusive water nymph, falls in love with the Prince, who happens to swim in her lake. Rusalka longs to become human herself so that she can be together with the Prince.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris conducted by Jaap van Zweden, current music director of the New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 2, Op. 18, No. 2
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.title: Summer Night Music - Love Songs
programme.desc: In Summer Night Music - Love Songs, artists from all over the world contribute their favourite love songs to an unusual and exciting event uniting classical, jazz, and world music. Among the classical musicians are the Gewandhaus Orchestra, cellist Mischa Maisky, and The King’s Singers. Other world stars include jazz vocalist Dee Dee Bridgewater and flamenco cantaora Mayte Martin.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.desc: Um jovem adolescente que tem uma amor cego pela mãe. Ele quer que os seus afectos sejam retribuídos, mas a mulher e mãe que tem na sua frente revela uma outra personalidade. A de uma mulher promiscua e sádica, para quem a imoralidade se pode tornar um vício.

programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Luís Represas sai em busca dos autores portugueses. Gente que escreve, compõe, pinta, encena, sempre no seu próprio mundo solitário, por vezes desconhecido de quem não vê TV, rádio, internet, exposições, passagens de modelos ou de quem não tem hábitos de leitura. De Macau a Timor, de Angola a São Tomé e Príncipe, de Cabo Verde a Moçambique, da Guiné ao Brasil, estes autores têm um denominador comum: a língua portuguesa.

programme.title: CNN M2 - Metro Quadrado
programme.desc: Um programa dedicado ao estado da arte no setor imobiliário em Portugal. Aqui, vamos ficamos a conhecer a realidade deste mercado, num tom aspiracional, mas realista, dirigido a todas famílias mas também aos agentes do setor. Ajudamos a conseguir bons negócios para a compra ou arrendamento, além de úteis conselhos para viver a sua casa! Mas não ficamos por aqui.

programme.title: Amanpour
programme.desc: O programa Amanpour é um programa sobre assuntos globais apresentado por Christiane Amanpour, jornalista da CNN, que apresenta entrevistas aprofundadas com líderes globais, influenciadores culturais e personalidades de destaque sobre questões críticas globais e nacionais.

programme.title: GTI Plus
programme.desc: GTi é um programa semanal de informação e entretenimento, essencialmente dedicado aos automóveis e à sua utilização nos diversos contextos - quotidiano, profissional, em viagem, competição.

programme.title: Pitch
programme.desc: No Pitch mostramos o mundo por detrás das marcas! As marcas desempenham um papel central na forma como vivemos em sociedade. Estão em todo o lado. Nos nossos ecrãs, casas, escritórios, na rua e a sua gestão nunca foi tão complexa! Neste programa vamos revelar os rostos que estão por detrás da gestão diária de marcas globais.

programme.title: O Admirável Mundo Com Richard Quest
programme.desc: O programa de viagens de Richard Quest pode, segundo o próprio, ser resumido numa frase: “vamos a lugares interessantes para conhecer pessoas fascinantes”. Quest viaja de cidade em cidade, procurando compreender o que move cada uma e as pessoas que nela vivem. O programa é também uma oportunidade para conhecer as personalidades e as histórias de cada lugar.

programme.title: CNN Travel: Vamos Explorar O Mundo
programme.desc: Um novo programa de viagens apresentado por Raquel Matos Cruz. Fruto de uma parceria entre a CNN Portugal e a Agência Abreu, cada episódio pretende inspirar os espectadores a aventurarem-se para além das suas fronteiras, dando a conhecer culturas vibrantes, paisagens únicas e experiências inesquecíveis nos mais variados destinos.

programme.desc: As tripulações do Northwestern, Seabrooke, Time Bandit, Wizard, Kodiak e Ramblin' Rose regressam às perigosas e gélidas águas do Mar de Bering para mais pesca ao caranguejo.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T7 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Viaje aos bastidores para saber como objetos do quotidiano são produzidos. Descubra como mastros de fibra de carbono, bolinhos da sorte e projetores IMAX são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T7 - Ep. 10

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T7 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Viaje aos bastidores para saber como objetos do quotidiano são produzidos. Descubra como as lâmpadas de halogénio, isolante de celulose e canas de pesca de bambu são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T7 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Viaje aos bastidores para saber como objetos do quotidiano são produzidos. Descubra o que é preciso para fazer brocas, cabines de fotografia e selos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T7 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Viaje aos bastidores para saber como objetos do quotidiano são produzidos. Descubra como os lemes, tapetes entrelaçados e termóstatos automóveis são feitos.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T13 - Ep. 11

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 64
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 33
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 34
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. programme.title: Runtown - La Machine de Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Enjoy Runtown’s first concert in Paris, where the Nigerian superstar brings many guests to his show. One of the most talented Nigerian afrobeat scenes will make you rediscover his greatest hits. Nigeria is a very creative country when it comes to the music scene. Runtown is no exception. His first single, “Party Like It’s 1980,” paved the way for “Gallardo,” which caught the entire international scene's attention.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Ben Sluijs
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content. Saxophonist Ben Sluijs received a classical training.

programme.title: Branford Marsalis Quartet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, jazz saxophonist Branford Marsalis brought his band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Fay Claassen: Two Portraits of Chet Baker
programme.desc: In 2013 it is 25 years ago that singer and trumpet player Chet Baker mysteriously died, caused by a fall from the window of his hotel room in Amsterdam. His music is more popular than ever. This concert is performed by Fay Claassen, who became internationally known through her album ‘Two Portraits of Chet Baker’. In the U.S. this album was the ‘Best Vocal Album of the Year’.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Fanfaraï
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Mathieu Jaton
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Scott DuBois Quartet Live In Munich
programme.desc: Rising star of the jazz guitar Scott DuBois leads his quartet, consisting of Gebhard Ullmann (reeds), Thomas Morgan (bass), and Kresten Osgood (drums), in an intimate and atmospheric performance at Munich’s Jazz Club Unterfahrt in March 2016. The group’s telepathy is such that they are able to go from deathly quiet to fiercely avant-garde at the drop of a hat.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Kaisa's Machine
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Trio Florizoone - Massot
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the trio Massot/Florizoone/Horbaczewski.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: Rumble
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: Eartha Kitt: The Most Exciting Woman in the World
programme.desc: They called her “the most exciting woman in the world”, and this Afro-American voice lived up to this expectation with international flair. Eartha Kitt was one of the reigning queens of blues and jazz. She epitomized the idea of the sex-kitten chanteuse, rising to fame with a nightclub act centered on her slinky stage presence and throaty purr.

programme.title: Mn'JAM Experiment: Live with a Boom
programme.desc: Imagine that visual arts and music are no longer two separate fields; that musicians no longer focus on their instruments only, but also on the visuals of their performance. Such is the premise of Mn'JAM Experiment!

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Rita Reys And The Pim Jacobs Trio at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Live in France: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: Jimmy Smith: Live in '69 boasts an incredible 90-minute concert from 1969 filmed in Paris. Working in his classic trio format with longtime guitarist Eddie McFadden and drummer Charlie Crosby, Jimmy shows why he is still the uncontested king of the jazz organ.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: TorTube: Tingvall Trio - Vägen
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jarrod Lawson
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Paolo Tomelleri
programme.desc: Highly acclaimed Italian clarinetist, saxophonist, and bandleader Paolo Tomelleri (1938) is a European master of traditional jazz and swing. With his Big Band, he performs updated recreations of classic swing-era charts made famous by the likes of Benny Goodman and Count Basie.

programme.title: Elliot Galvin Trio - November Music
programme.desc: The annual international festival November Music was first held in 1993. Since then, the festival has been promoting contemporary music across various locations in the Netherlands city ‘s-Hertogenbosch. Its 2018 edition included jazz, avant-garde, world and electronic music, sound installations, modern opera and theatre, as well as various interdisciplinary performances.

programme.title: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: I Will Not Be Sad
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival, held in Osnabrueck, has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Jivan Gasparyan Jr has always been inspired by the folk melodies of his native Armenia.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 And 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Rebirth: Richard Lemz
programme.desc: Amsterdam, February 6th, 2018 - The short documentary Rebirth in The Amsterdam Red Light District illustrates how brutal Richard Lems' life as an addict was and his struggle to unshackle himself from the shame. Filled with fierce, freighting, and sad moments, Richard relives his stabbing, stay in jail, drug test, and drug use.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Berlin
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Forest GIIPUJA
programme.desc: GIIPUJA has been bringing modern jazz with a distinct ethnic flavor to Croatian audiences since 2013. The unusual line-up of double bass, drums, bass clarinet, violin, and various folkloristic instruments from the Istria region, makes for a strikingly original and unique sound.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Nardozza - Bisceglia
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Soul Makossa: Manu Dibango in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Manu Dibango, one of Africa’s biggest musical stars and top saxophonists, is an indispensable artist. He was one of the first African musicians to score a worldwide hit with his 1972 release “Soul Makossa”, paving the way for many other artists. The very concept of world music owes much to him.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.title: Carrie Smith
programme.desc: Veteran American blues and jazz singer Carrie Smith (1925-2012) was often compared to the legendary Bessie Smith, an artist she greatly admired. She was best known in Europe for her powerful, resonant voice, impeccable timing, and the emotional depth she brought to her songs.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Sixring Circus
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Moonlight Benjamin - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Teus Nobel live at the Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Teus Nobel is a Dutch trumpet and flugelhorn player. As a little boy, he was inspired by ‘power’ trumpeters such as Maynard Ferguson and Bill Chase. While studying at the conservatory, he played both as jazz player and as a commercial session musician at musicals. After his time at the conservatory, he started playing in the Royal Netherlands Air Force Orchestra, playing march music influenced by pop and jazz.

programme.title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64?highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer’s band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins’ band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Paradox Live: BRUUT!
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow.

programme.title: Peter Beets Trio And Goudsmit: Tribute to Montgomery
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.desc: Programa em forma de revista eletrônica, o Show da Vida mistura jornalismo, denúncia, esporte, humor, dramaturgia, documentário, música e ciência.

programme.title: Altas Horas - Ep. 1268
programme.desc: Apresentado por Serginho Groisman, os assuntos abordados no programa incluem música, dança, entrevistas, comentários e arte. A plateia do Altas Horas é formada totalmente por jovens e adolescentes que interagem com o apresentador e com as atrações.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 145
programme.desc: Joaquim esconde o dinheiro da polícia, mas acaba sendo preso por Paulinho pelo roubo das Três Graças. Ferette e Arminda não encontram o dinheiro, e o empresário ameaça Lígia. Joaquim é levado para a delegacia por Paulinho, sem poder contar a Lígia e ao pastor Albérico onde o dinheiro está escondido. Ferette pensa em desaparecer com Viviane, para que Leonardo não se junte à farmacêutica.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 146
programme.desc: Lena insiste em dizer a Herculano que a criança não reconhece seu colo de mãe. Gerluce, Joélly e Lígia selam um pacto para nunca mentirem uma para a outra. Viviane aceita a ajuda de Angélico para limpar a casa. Ferette manda Macedo descobrir algo contra o pai de Juquinha, ao saber que foi ele o desembargador que assinou a liminar para reintegrar Rogério como presidente da Fundação.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 147
programme.desc: Viviane diz a Angelico que não consegue trair seu coração. Viviane conta a Gerluce que ainda ama Leonardo. Xênica, Rogério, Zenilda e Leonardo encontram um celular no cofre da sala que era ocupada por Ferette. Bagdá revela a Pastor Albérico que não está conseguindo sair do crime. Lorena se surpreende com a visita de Ferette a sua casa.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 148
programme.desc: Lorena chora com a visita de Ferette a sua casa, e o empresário zomba da reação da filha. Herculano avisa a Lena que a mulher tem de cortar relações com Joélly. Kasper e Maggye se surpreendem quando Bagdá pergunta se pode ficar um tempo em sua casa. Paulinho se espanta quando Gerluce impõe condição para aceitar o pedido de casamento.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 149
programme.desc: Paulinho estranha quando Gerluce condiciona o casamento a cada um continuar morando em sua casa. Lígia comenta com Joélly que acha estranho Lena ter saído do país depois do que aconteceu. Lorena diz a Juquinha que Ferette a fez chorar como criança. Kasper e Maggye se surpreendem quando Bagdá pergunta se pode ficar um tempo em sua casa. Lucélia assume o lugar de Bagdá na Chacrinha.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 150
programme.desc: Rogério e Zenilda celebram o aceite de Gerluce para ser presidente da Fundação. Ferette diz a Arminda que impugnará a liminar que deu poderes a Rogério. Gerluce readmite Viviane como responsável pela farmácia da Chacrinha. Ferette pensa na revelação que é pai de Raul. Ferette recebe convocação da polícia para esclarecer sua ida à Chacrinha. Paulinho se sente ameaçado por Ferette.

programme.title: Lady Night - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Xandy de Pilares e Péricles se divertem no Lady Night em um jeito totalmente novo. Até quem não gosta de samba vai rir, e quem gosta nunca viu os dois assim.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 19
programme.desc: O carro de Irene atola e ela aceita a ajuda de Zé Bolacha. Marcelo expulsa Isabela do quarto. Ana não cede à pressão dos filhos para revelar qual deles tem outro pai.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 48
programme.desc: Serena é regida por sentimentos ruins ao encontrar Guto. Ivan tenta se aproveitar de Mirna. Vitório beija Olívia. Cristina se preocupa com as visões de Serena.

programme.title: Malhação - Sonhos T22 - Ep. 257
programme.desc: Bianca e Duca relembram os velhos tempos. Cobra chama Karina para ser sua madrinha de casamento. Os meninos resolvem fazer uma despedida de solteiro para Cobra.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 37
programme.desc: Ema garante a Amélia que o sentimento que tem por Jorge é amizade. Uirapuru inventa uma desculpa para não ir ao casamento e Tibúrcio pede que Brandão acompanhe Mariana no altar. Cecília casa com Rômulo, e Tibúrcio passa mal ao vê-la com o vestido de Josephine. Xavier ameaça Julieta e Susana, que prejudicam as negociações do vilão. Mariana discute com Darcy e Elisabeta por conta de Uirapuru.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 126
programme.desc: Naiane devolve a medalha de Cecília para Agrado. Ana Castela se encanta cada vez mais com Gael. Zilá afirma a Ronei que conseguirá tudo o que deseja durante o divórcio de Alaorzinho. Alaor resgata Walmir da companhia de Adilson, e Irene se preocupa com o amado. Cinara se desespera ao sonhar com o romance entre Ronei e Zilá. Agrado se machuca, e Janete socorre a filha. Walmir furta o dinheiro.

programme.title: Conversa Com Bial - Ep. 1533
programme.desc: Uma conversa não é feita apenas de assuntos. Saber falar, ter o que dizer, ouvir e escutar são igualmente importantes para a construção de um diálogo.

programme.title: Rainha da Sucata - Ep. 133
programme.desc: Edu sofre pela separação e confessa que ama Maria do Carmo. Renato descobre que Caio tirou o dinheiro do banco. Adriana descobre o paradeiro da chave do cofre.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 96
programme.desc: Maurílio ameaça Comendador e revela ter provas contra ele. Cris fica desolada ao ver Vicente e Maria Clara juntos. Comendador e Isis fazem amor no carro dele.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 84

programme.title: A Nobreza Do Amor - Ep. 28
programme.desc: Alika promete se vingar de Jendal e limpar a memória de Cayman. Adalgisa e Mirinho despistam Virgínia. Omar desperta chamando por Alika, e Jendal se enfurece. Adalgisa se insinua para Mirinho. Onildo tem suspeita sobre Vera. Alika e Niara pensam em ir ao Rio de Janeiro conseguir apoio para a intervenção em Batanga. Virgínia e Lúcia/Alika se encontram na estação de trem.

programme.title: Jornal Da Band

programme.title: Jantar O Quê?
programme.desc: Quando chega à noite, bate aquela vontade de desfrutar um momento gostoso, nesta hora, uma mesma dúvida nasce em muitos corações e estômagos diferentes: jantar o quê? Esta saborosa questão inspirou a criação do programa apresentado pela jornalista e chef de cozinha Larissa Januário. Em cada dia da semana, larissa vai ajudar os espectadores a fazer melhor escolha para o seu jantar.

programme.title: Tempo Técnico
programme.desc: Comandado por Elia Jr., o programa também terá na bancada os comentaristas Jorge Nicola e Sálvio Spínola (ex-árbitro e considerado um dos maiores analistas de arbitragem do Brasil). Análises táticas, debates e entrevistas com os principais técnicos do futebol Brasileiro.

programme.title: Depois Do Jogo
programme.desc: Com apresentação de Thomaz Rafael e Júlio gomes, o depois do jogo destaca os gols da rodada, analisa os resultados e discute as polêmicas do mundo da bola.

programme.desc: Um programa semanal dedicado à mobilidade inteligente e ao mundo automóvel. Com informação detalhada, numa linguagem acessível, rubricas de utilidade, curiosidades sobre automóveis, condução segura e equipamentos. As principais novidades das tecnologias orientadas para o condutor e passageiros. Apresentação de Patrícia Pereira e Vítor Mendes.

programme.desc: Conduzido por Ângela Marques, editora executiva da revista Sábado, o GPS mostra-lhe os restaurantes, hotéis, bares, esplanadas e todas as novidades que tem mesmo de conhecer. Em simultâneo, o Guia Para Sair sugere-lhe séries, filmes, discos, teatros e exposições – para todas as idades e públicos – para que possa aproveitar da melhor forma o seu tempo de lazer.

programme.title: Global 5.0 T3 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: O que vai mudar com a aplicação da Inteligência Artificial nas várias vertentes em que estão a ser desenvolvidas? Desde a medicina, defesa, compilação de dados, será a Inteligência Artificial uma ameaça ou uma oportunidade? Todas as novidades que as revistas científicas mais prestigiadas em todo o mundo trazem, os principais projetos que os investigadores portugueses espalhados pelo mundo estão a desenvolver.
